[RDSC.5a.7d.3] `window_ns > 0` is required — `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque` backs `min` / `max`
on `sliding` only (exact `min` / `max` on `all_time` use `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma`).
`max_samples` carries the series' `capacity` ([LSER.13.14]) and caps
the entries each identity retains; `0` means the window is the only bound.
